title: Dynamic proxy pool reconciler control plane
description: Background reconciler that syncs free-proxy sources, probes egress IPs, deduplicates by canonical identity, refills pools toward desiredReadyCount, expires stale members, and clears expired cooldowns. Feature-gated by OMNIROUTE_DYNAMIC_PROXY_POOLS_ENABLED.
internal_description: Adds the dynamic proxy pool reconciler (src/lib/dynamicProxyPool/reconciler.ts), migration 126 with sources/scan_concurrency/last_reconciled_at columns, lifecycle DB functions (update/delete/unbind/removeMember), extended management API (update/unbind/removeMember/reconcile/delete), scheduler wiring in instrumentation-node.ts, architecture diagram, and 9 new TDD reconciler tests (17/17 focused tests pass).
